feature: Native country flags and flight-manifest presentation
runtime_flags: Country imagery uses native maskedShieldType and GetFlag properties, following MD's existing EU and international-system interfaces. Current country identity, ideology and cosmetic-tag handling remain with the engine. No country-flag texture atlas or fixed list of countries is generated.
surfaces: Active guest delegation in National Brief

new_chrome.author_credit: Custom code-generated layout and institutional panel artwork by Codex for the user's project
new_chrome.licence_or_permission: Project-specific additions; a separate redistribution licence has not been supplied
new_chrome.modifications: Original panel outlines, small engraved helmet cue, state badges, a national/partner share bar and a neutral country-selection placeholder. All readable labels are native UI text. No photographic content, flag pixels or visible watermarks are baked into these textures.

reference_code: common/scripted_guis/00_missiles_scripted_guis.txt: country-variable and THIS GetFlag image properties
native_flag_donors.author_credit: Existing Hearts of Iron IV / Millennium Dawn native flag presentation; individual original artists unknown in this checkout
native_flag_donors.licence_or_permission: Original upstream and game rights remain separate. Separate redistribution permission is unknown. Existing assets are referenced without editing or copying them into the generated asset bank.
native_flag_donors.modifications: None to upstream flag, mask or overlay files. New local GFX registrations and read-only country-variable bindings use the existing native effect.

preview.method: Offline composition from generated native GUI/GFX and bitmap fonts, not a live HOI4 capture
preview.flag_fixtures: Offline-only fixture identities follow the 1970 country histories: SOV_Coldwar_Communism, DDR_DDR, POL_communist, FRA_1970 and the US democratic flag. Runtime uses native GetFlag instead of these fixture mappings.
preview.font_provenance: Existing Bahnschrift atlas provenance in orbital-atlas-notice.json remains applicable

mechanics: No changes to mission success probabilities, award shares, training charges or provider eligibility. New variables represent flags, badges, partner financing and percentage-bar frames only.
